package.title: An Experimental Study of Collective Deliberation
package.method: Laboratory experiment (jury-style collective decision), 3x3x2 between-session design

engine: anomalyco/opencode (ReproAI) — DeepSeek V4 Flash via uniGPT
mode: static audit + independent R reimplementation from shipped raw per-period data (plus Python preprocessing/cross-check)

host_environment.note: No author analysis code shipped in the package; all recomputation performed in R against raw behavior .txt files.

data_source.location: Econometric Society supplemental archive (article browse page): /publications/econometrica/2011/05/01/experimental-study-collective-deliberation  [supp/8852_data and programs_0.zip]

contains.behavior: Data/BehaviorOutcomes/*.txt (17 sessions x 10-col per-round records, comm/no-comm)
contains.code: none shipped (package named 'data and programs' contains data only)

headline_results.tableIII_no_comm: reproduces near-exactly across hom/het/part and rules (strategic-voting comparative statics)
headline_results.tableIV_flag: homogeneous no-chat Red sample marginal effect 0.814 reproduces exactly (MEM convention)

integrity_issues.issue: duplicated per-subject rows in periods 1-5 (540 rows vs 324 expected)
integrity_issues.impact: naive part r9 comm majority-red = 40% vs paper 84.4%

integrity_issues.issue: shipped but not used in paper comm hom r7 analysis (N=486 matches HOM_7_27 only)
